title: The Detection of Invisible Abnormal Metabolism in the FDG-PET Images of Patients With Anti-LGI1 Encephalitis by Machine Learning
summary: The study reports disease/control metabolic differences in evaluated PET images. Findings are bounded to the studied groups and image analysis; independent replication and clinical benefit are not established.
